messages:
alex: Proposal: unify token model so a single token type can be scoped to org/project/service-account and carry routing + quota claims. Sketch below 1 want eng-platform + console + billing input.

mike: Quick question 1 backwards compatibility? we can't break existing project keys in the short term.

sara: Console UX note 1 if we expose routing preferences at token creation, we need a migration wizard and clear copy about guarantees vs hints.

jenny: Telemetry/billing concern 1 we need token-level labels for attribution (org, project, sa). Also quotas must be enforceable at the gateway with those labels.

lee: Infra note 1 routing policy claims should be constrained to pref_region, capacity_tier, fallback_model_set. Need to ensure tokens cannot escalate to higher tiers.

alex: Draft claim example:
```yaml
token_claims:
  scope: project:proj_123
  roles: [ingest, generate]
  routing:
    pref_region: us-west-2
    tier: dedicated
```
This is illustrative 1 debate: opaque token vs signed JWT.

mike: Signed JWT => easy cross-service validation, but revocation is harder.

jenny: Telemetry team leans signed JWT for label propagation into traces, but rotation/revocation is a real issue. Compromise: short-lived JWTs minted by a secure service-account flow (opaque SA token -> exchange for short JWT).

sara: Console flow idea: when creating a service-account token show a checkbox 'pin to project billing' and a small tooltip: 'billing attribution = project by default; override only with org-level owner consent'. Keep copy short and make override gated.

lee: My practical preference: opaque token ID -> server-side claim store. Gateway validates ID against mapping table, applies routing/quota. Simpler for rollout, revocation, and dynamic policy changes.

deploy-bot: PR 4821 linked 1 adds token_mapping table + telemetry labels to event-stream. https://git.internal/r/4821 :eyes:

alex: Action items: mike + lee prototype opaque token + mapping (POC this week), jenny to write telemetry label spec, sara to mock console migration UX. Sync Fri 10am. Thanks :raised_hands:
